bank_roles.1: 25 MHz TCXO + Raspberry Pi HAT+ SPI/UART/PPS host interface

uart.primary_use: DCF77 date/time telemetry FPGA to Raspberry Pi

source_policy: Checked against Lattice FPGA-SC-02034 (ECP5U-45 pinout, BG256) and the current Raspberry Pi HAT+ specification before fabrication. scripts/verify-bga-identity.ts enforces this file against the generated BGA footprint and fails if ball names were renumbered or reordered by an exporter.

ball_grid.naming_convention: JESD-95 style BGA ball naming; row letters I, O, Q and S are omitted (16 rows x 16 columns)
ball_grid.orientation: A1 is the top-left corner as seen from the component side; row A at the top, column 1 at the left
ball_grid.pad_numbering: row-major from the top-left corner; pin1 = A1, pin16 = A16, pin17 = B1, pin256 = T16

ball_audit.documented_scope: every ball named by docs/23, docs/27 and this plan (signal, sysconfig, reserved and power balls)
ball_audit.unverified_scope: remaining BG256 balls: identity is grid-derived, not yet cross-checked against Lattice FPGA-SC-02034
ball_audit.identity_canonical_form: pad:ball:rowcol:signal:kind, one line per ball, LF-joined, UTF-8
ball_audit.gate: scripts/verify-bga-identity.ts fails on any grid, order, name or hash change; fabrication stays blocked until the unresolved balls are cross-checked against FPGA-SC-02034 and documented_balls reaches 256
